description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for five tiny-model fine-tuning/quantization variants. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from the low 20s up to 70, with major ticks shown at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. The solid gray line with circle markers (“tiny AdaLoRA_int4”) decreases from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 60 (epoch 1), ~55 (epoch 2), ~45 (epoch 3), ~40 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~36 (epoch 6). The solid gray line with square markers (“tiny AdaLoRA_int8”) drops from about 60 at epoch 0 to ~51 (epoch 1), ~50 (epoch 2), ~44 (epoch 3), ~37 (epoch 4), ~35–36 (epoch 5), and ~32 (epoch 6). The dashed gray line with circle markers (“tiny int4”) declines from about 69 at epoch 0 to ~55 (epoch 1), ~49 (epoch 2), ~44 (epoch 3), ~40 (epoch 4), then stays near ~39 at epoch 5 and rises slightly to ~40 at epoch 6. The dashed gray line with square markers (“tiny int8”) decreases from about 59–60 at epoch 0 to ~47 (epoch 1), ~46 (epoch 2), ~43 (epoch 3), ~39 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~37 (epoch 6). The dotted gray line with triangle markers (“tiny full”) starts near ~29 at epoch 0 and trends downward to ~27 (epoch 1), ~27 (epoch 2), ~24 (epoch 3), ~24 (epoch 4), ~23–24 (epoch 5), and ~23 (epoch 6).
